text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the first day of summer camp. It's a period of intense training where racers can improve upon their practical skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or… that's what it's supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Are you ready, guinea pig? The number of experiments that can only be done during the summer rivals the number of stars in space!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Don't give in to the heat. I'll need you to be on your best guinea pig behavior!
choice_data_list: You know this summer camp is meant for you, right?!
You know this summer camp is meant for you, right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A full-fledged adult shouldn't concern themselves with such trifling matters. Come, let's enjoy summer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Such was the calm before the inevitable storm that would ensue during summer camp with Agnes Tachyon!
